subject: Request: one-time hosted API rate waiver for Hospitron pilot
messages:
From: Emily Chen <emily@hospitron.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 27 Sep 2028 08:10:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood Hosted API — pricing ask for pilot

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency profile and batching features look promising for our triage workflows. We ran the numbers on projected tokens for a 3-month pilot (see attached forecast) and our procurement team is requesting a one-time concession to make the economics work for an early-stage proof. Specifically: would Redwood consider a 30–35% off list rate for the first 90 days of the pilot? This would enable us to get to volume quickly and evaluate multi-region routing.

We’re prepared to commit to a 12-month paid pilot (billing via PO) if we can get a concession up front. Can you confirm whether that’s something you can escalate?

Thanks,
Emily Chen
Head of Product
Hospitron

Attachment: Hospitron_usage_forecast_Q4-Q1.xlsx (spreadsheet; projected tokens by month)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Chen <emily@hospitron.ai>
Date: Thu, 27 Sep 2028 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood Hosted API — pricing ask for pilot

Hi Emily — appreciated the recon call. I’ve looped in our Deal Desk and sales leadership to review. Two quick clarifying questions before I escalate formally:

1) Is the 12-month paid pilot a firm PO/commit or an MSA + conditional PO after pilot kickoff?
2) Do you need the concession applied to both generation and embedding usage?

I’ve attached the forecast you sent and will follow up internally this morning — aim to get an answer within the day.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>
Cc: deals@redwood.ai, legal@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 27 Sep 2028 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Requesting exec pricing waiver: Hospitron pilot — asking >20%

Team,

Quick summary: Hospitron (strategic healthcare triage vendor) is requesting a one-time, up-front discount of 30–35% off Hosted API list for the first 90 days of a 12-month paid pilot. They are a market-influential buyer in the US emergency triage space; if the pilot performs they’ve indicated willingness to expand to multi-region production and a 24–36 month enterprise contract.

Why I’m asking for an exception now:
- Forecasted first-year consumption (conservative) = ~$420k ARR if they convert; first 90-day pilot spend is meaningful but front-loaded.
- Competitive urgency: they are evaluating two other vendors with lower sticker and have procurement pressure to hit a near-term budget.
- Technical fit: Redwood’s batching + KV cache is a clear throughput win for them; early win likely to cascade to additional lines of business.

Requested concession (commercial ask):
- One-time 28% discount off token rates for the first 90 days of the pilot (applies to generation + embedding).
- Requirement: signed MSA + PO for the 12-month paid pilot in place before pilot kick (no trial-only verbals).
- Addendum: Redwood to receive explicit right to reference Hospitron as strategic pilot customer; PR approval by Hospitron marketing team.

Risks and mitigations:
- Revenue dilution early: mitigated by PO requirement and conversion incentives (step-up pricing after 90 days).
- SLA asks: they may ask for data residency wording — looped legal.

Attachments: usage forecast and a short proposed SOW (draft) included in the thread.

Ask: Marcus / Ben — can you approve a one-time concession in the 25–30% range? If approved, I’ll draft the SOW/DocuSign flow and coordinate legal for the addendum.

Thx,
Karthik
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.ai>, legal@redwood.ai, finance@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 27 Sep 2028 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Requesting exec pricing waiver: Hospitron pilot — asking >20%

Karthik — thanks for the concise ask and the forecast. I’m supportive of an exception given the strategic optics and the conversion potential, with the following guardrails:

1) Approve a one-time 28% off list for first 90 days (applies to both gen + embed) conditional on:
   - Signed MSA and PO for 12 months received prior to pilot start;
   - Minimum committed spend floor for the first month (to avoid token chargebacks) — suggest $15k minimum.
2) Finance to model and confirm ARR impact (cc’d). If finance flags a concern, we’ll need to narrow to 25% max.
3) Legal to add a 90-day pricing addendum and a clause that the discount is non-precedential. Legal, please confirm you can turn a redline within 48 hours.

If finance/legal are good, Karthik — proceed to generate a DocuSign SOW with these terms and include a clause that the special pricing expires if PO is not received within 21 days of the offer. Keep marketing in the loop for the reference ask.

—Marcus
VP Sales | Redwood Inference

Quoted: On Thu, 27 Sep 2028 09:05:00 -0700, Karthik Iyer wrote:
> Team, Quick summary: Hospitron (strategic healthcare triage vendor) is requesting a one-time, up-front discount of 30–35%...

Attachment: Hospitron_SOW_v1_draft.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Chen <emily@hospitron.ai>, David Park <d.park@hospitron.ai>, procure@hospitron.ai
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, legal@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 27 Sep 2028 11:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood Hosted API — pricing ask for pilot (approved concession)

Emily — good news. Leadership has authorized a one-time concession to support the pilot:

Offer summary:
- One-time concession: 28% off our standard Hosted API token rates applied to generation and embedding for the first 90 days of the pilot.
- Preconditions: Signed MSA and a PO covering the 12-month paid pilot must be received before pilot kickoff. We’ll require a $15k minimum billing for month 1 (to protect against billing volatility).
- Timebox: PO must be issued within 21 days of acceptance of the SOW.
- After 90 days, rates will revert to the contracted list unless a conversion/renewal amendment is executed.

Next steps: I’m attaching the draft SOW and DocuSign link — link will include the pricing addendum Marcus requested and the non-precedential language. Please review with procurement and confirm whether Hospitron can provide the PO by Oct 18. If you want an alternate cadence for the step-up pricing post-pilot, say so and we can model it.

DocuSign SOW draft: https://docusign.redwood.ai/s/abcdef123456
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

Thanks — excited to get this moving.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
